annotations.title: Find a symbol from a name

description: Maps free text, such as a company name or a former ticker, to exchange symbols with a match score. Required: query, 2 to 80 characters. Returns 5 matches by default, up to 25. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

query.description: Company name or ticker, for example Reliance Industries.

name: resolve
